sentences.text:
This Writ Petition Is Filed Questioning ... vs Unknown on 2
November, 2020
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy

Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 1
 Cmr, J.
 W.P.No.20160 of 2020
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Writ Petition No.20160 of 2020
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of respondents 3 and 4 in frequently following the petitioner and in making frequent visits to his house and keeping a watch over him and thereby interfering with his personal liberty and freedom to freely move.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home appearing for respondents.
3.

It is the case of the petitioner in this writ petition that a case in Crime No.128 of 2020 was registered by the 5th respondent Station House Officer, Amadaguru P.S. against the petitioner for the offences under Sections 272, 273, 328 of IPC and Sections 57(1), 58 r/w.Secs.26(1) and 30(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act on the allegation that he has been in possession of banned tobacco products and in the month of August, 2020 in connection with a civil dispute, a panchayat was held before the Tanakallu Police and at that time, the 4th respondent was the Sub-Inspector of Police in the said Police Station and he has indulged in settling the said civil dispute and as such, the petitioner made a complaint against him to his superior officers and his superior officers warned him.

Therefore, the 4th respondent bore-grudge against the petitioner and threatened him to implicate in false criminal cases and he has been also frequently following him to kill him in a fake encounter and also CMR, J.
keeping watch over him by making frequent visits to his house and thereby interfering with his freedom to move.
4. Learned Government Pleader for Home would submit that except registering the above crime against the petitioner, either the 4th respondent or any of the respondents herein did not interfere with his personal liberty and they never made any attempt to follow him, or to keep watch on his movements at his house and they are all false and imaginary allegations made by the petitioner This Writ Petition Is Filed Questioning ... vs Unknown on 2 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10451664/
1 against the respondents.

He would also submit, on instructions, that there are no grave offences registered against the petitioner to keep surveillance on him by making frequent visits to his house to keep watch on his movements.
He would finally submit that the aforesaid allegations made against the respondents are all imaginary and false allegations.

5. Therefore, in view of the aforesaid submission made by the learned Government Pleader for Home, on instructions, that no grave offences are registered against the petitioner except the aforesaid crime and that police never made any attempt to interfere with his right to move freely or with his personal liberty, recording the same, this Writ Petition is closed.
The miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall also stand closed.

.
